info.title: API.SH: Webmotors
info.description: The Webmotors API from API.SH: public Webmotors data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The lifestyle categories Webmotors uses to group cars (electric cars, SUVs, family cars, luxury cars, first car...): name, slug, id, link and banners. Pass a name as `lifestyle` to the search.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/webmotors-categories

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Webmotors FIPE and market price table
get.description:
The FIPE and Webmotors price table for one vehicle version and model year: FIPE code, FIPE price used and new with the reference month, lowest and highest asking price, the Webmotors average price band nationally and in a state (listings, lowest, average, highest; armoured and not armoured), the 12-month history of the FIPE price (used and new) and the Webmotors average (armoured and not), technical highlights (engine, transmission, safety, comfort, technology) and the other versions of that model year with their FIPE codes. Find make, model, year and version slugs with /webmotors/v1/fipe-catalog. Motorcycles take make, model and year only.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/webmotors-fipe

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Cars: version slug from /webmotors/v1/fipe-catalog (motorcycles: ignored, any value).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Brazilian state code for the state price band (SP, RJ).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Webmotors FIPE table makes, models, years and versions
get.description:
Browse the FIPE price table the way the site does: no make gives every make; a make gives its models (with image); make and model give the model years with the lowest and highest FIPE price of each year; make, model and year give the versions with their slugs and FIPE codes (cars). Use the slugs with /webmotors/v1/fipe.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/webmotors-fipe-catalog

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Webmotors listing: everything the search returns plus publish and creation dates, every optional item, lifestyle categories, colours, plate ending, the FIPE code and price, and the market price band for that version in the seller's state (FIPE price, lowest, average and highest asking price on Webmotors, update dates). Business sellers come with name, address, CNPJ, opening hours and the start of their phone number as the page shows it; private sellers with the first name the site shows, city and state (no phone). Pass a listing link from the search (its `url`), or `latest=true` with search filters to get the first current match.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/webmotors-listing

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: A webmotors.com.br/comprar/... listing link (the `url` field of the search).

parameters.name: latest
parameters.description: true: open the first listing the search with the other params returns (make, model, state, ...).

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: With latest: search filter. With id: the listing's make.

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: With latest: search filter. With id: the listing's model.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Listing id (the number at the end of the link); needs make, model and version (cars) or cc (motorcycles).

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: With id: the listing's version as the site shows it.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The official brand and dealer stores and the sales fairs Webmotors currently runs (e.g. Black Feirão, Loja Oficial BMW): id, name, slug, vehicle type, link and banners. Pass a name as `offer` to the search to list its vehicles.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/webmotors-offers

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Search Webmotors (Brazil's largest car and motorcycle marketplace) with every filter the site's search offers: condition (new/used), make, model and version (up to three makes), state and city, year, price, mileage, engine size, power, trunk and tank capacity, transmission, fuel, colour, body type, doors, plate ending, armoured or not, seller type, vehicle attributes (single owner, IPVA paid...), optional items, lifestyle category, traction, wheel size, opportunities (below FIPE, WhatsApp, car delivery...), auction history, photos only, official stores and fairs, one dealer's stock; for motorcycles also cylinder capacity, cooling, starter, gears, brakes and fuel system. Each vehicle: id, listing link, title, make/model/version with ids, model and manufacture year, mileage, price, financing preview, percent of the FIPE price, good-deal flag, transmission, fuel, body, doors, colours, engine, power, traction, trunk, tank, wheels, attributes, description, seller (business sellers with name, address, CNPJ; private sellers with the first name the site shows, city and state, no phone), photos. Also returns the total, the site's facet counts for every filter (makes with models and versions, states, years, colours...) and the site search link. The site serves at most 417 pages. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/webmotors-search

parameters.name: make
parameters.description: Make name (toyota, honda, volkswagen). Up to three, comma-separated; the n-th model and version belong to the n-th make (see /webmotors/v1/makes).

parameters.name: model
parameters.description: Model name for the make (corolla, civic).

parameters.name: version
parameters.description: Version name as the site lists it (e.g. 2.0 XEI 16V FLEX 4P AUTOMÁTICO).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Brazilian state code (SP, RJ, MG) or its name.

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City name within `state` (Campinas, Rio de Janeiro).

parameters.name: transmission
parameters.description: Comma-separated: Automática, Manual, CVT, Automatizada, Semi-automática...

parameters.name: fuel
parameters.description: Comma-separated: Gasolina e álcool, Gasolina, Diesel, Elétrico, Gasolina e elétrico...

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Comma-separated colours: Branco, Preto, Cinza, Prata, Azul, Vermelho...

parameters.name: body_type
parameters.description: Comma-separated: Utilitário esportivo, Hatchback, Sedã, Picape, Minivan, Cupê, Conversível (motorcycles: Street, Trail, Scooter, Custom, Naked...).

parameters.name: plate_end
parameters.description: Comma-separated plate-ending groups: 1 e 2, 3 e 4, 5 e 6, 7 e 8, 9 e 0.

parameters.name: armored
parameters.description: true for armoured only, false for not armoured.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Comma-separated: Único dono, IPVA pago, Licenciado, Garantia de fábrica, Aceita troca...

parameters.name: features
parameters.description: Comma-separated optional items: Teto solar, Bancos em couro, Câmera de ré...

parameters.name: lifestyle
parameters.description: Comma-separated categories: Carros elétricos, SUVs, Carros para família, Carros de luxo... (see /webmotors/v1/categories).

parameters.name: traction
parameters.description: Comma-separated: Dianteira, Traseira, Integral permanente, Integral parcial.

parameters.name: opportunities
parameters.description: Comma-separated: Super Preco (below FIPE), Com Financiamento, Possui WhatsApp, Responde Rapido, Troca com troco, Car Delivery, Vistoriado.

parameters.name: auction_history
parameters.description: true: only vehicles with auction history; false: only without.

parameters.name: dealer_id
parameters.description: A business seller's id: that dealer's stock.

parameters.name: starter
parameters.description: Motorcycles: elétrica, pedal, pedal e elétrica.

parameters.name: engine_type
parameters.description: Motorcycles: 4 Tempos, 2 Tempos, Elétrico de corrente contínua.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
